anomalies.description: A large, sudden explosion occurs on the road ahead of a group of people, producing a massive white and brown dust/fireball plume that rapidly expands and obscures the scene.

A large, sudden explosion occurs on the roadside embankment, producing a rapidly expanding fireball and dust cloud that peaks around 14.5–15.0 s and begins to collapse by 16.5 s.; A large, violent explosion occurs on the roadside, producing a rapidly expanding fireball, dense smoke plume (initially orange/brown, then dark grey), and a massive dust/steam cloud that engulfs the area over ~7.5 seconds. The blast appears to originate from a vehicle or object near the road embankment.

A second distinct explosion occurs at the same location, with a new fireball and dust plume rising, visible from 18.0 s onward and persisting through 19.5 s.; A large, violent explosion occurs on the roadside, beginning with a rapid upward ejection of dust and debris (f0), forming a massive hemispherical dust cloud that expands outward (f1–f7), then collapses inward as the initial shock dissipates (f8–f9), revealing a burning fireball and thick black smoke rising from the epicenter (f10–f15). The explosion is sustained and evolves over the full interval.

A large, sustained explosion with a fireball and dense smoke plume erupts from a vehicle or object on the roadside, expanding and rising over ~7.5 seconds. The initial blast is visible at f0 (24.0s) as a massive dust/smoke cloud, followed by emergence of orange flame and black smoke through f2–f12, peaking around f6–f8, then gradually dissipating but still clearly explosive in nature through f15 (31.5s).
A large, rapidly expanding fireball and smoke plume erupts on the right side of the road, consistent with a sudden high-energy explosion.

A group of people is seen running away from the explosion site along the roadside; their rapid, coordinated flight suggests collective violent unrest or response to an explosive incident in a conflict zone.
